objective: Replace decorative prediction with causal, validated, persistent forecasting and make every execution path fail closed without qualified evidence.

architecture: candles -> predictive model -> neural decision -> SDCA
crisis observations -> statistical sensors -> calibrated aggregate
terminal outcomes -> expert reliability -> execution policy
qualified inference -> prepared order envelope -> broker
critical_findings: F51 can pass nearly empty evidence with artificial confidence.
RSI contains look-ahead and MACD signal is not an EMA signal line.
quantum_bias has no market input and is non-empirical.
NeuralDecisionExpert publishes hardcoded probabilities and the active MLP leaks time.
Neural veto is not required at the broker boundary.
Crisis aggregation converts missing evidence into normal/green.
GrowthAtRisk is not quantile regression; SRISK and network contagion use invalid proxies.
Outcome learning lacks expert direction and does not consume its computed reward.
indirect_consumers: contract, integration, property and browser tests
breakage_risks: Artificially high scores will become unavailable or blocked.
Canonical RSI and MACD will change historical snapshots.
Insufficient samples will cause abstention instead of fabricated forecasts.
Execution contracts will require qualified, fresh, symbol-bound inference.
patch_sequence: Remove false certainty from F51 and MathHub.
Correct causal indicators, bootstrap scenarios, backtest and HRP.
Build a persistent time-ordered predictive champion with calibration and abstention.
Replace or disable misnamed crisis models according to available real data.
Use directional proper scoring for adaptive reliability.
Bind qualified inference and veto to every order envelope.
Run focused, property, full-suite and live browser verification.

research_basis: Adaptive conformal inference under distribution shift
Hamilton-filter Markov switching, Hawkes maximum likelihood, proper LPPLS

baseline.workspace: User runtime data and diagnostics remain dirty and must not be staged or reverted.
